name: Disappointed Black Guy
look: White space on the left for captions, split by a horizontal line, sits beside two close-ups of a young Black man in front of an ornate patterned wall. Top: he grins broadly with bright eyes. Bottom: his smile is gone, replaced by a flat, disappointed look.
use: Shows excitement collapsing into disappointment. The top-left caption is good news or a hopeful expectation that makes him grin, and the bottom-left caption reveals the catch that wipes the smile off his face.
slots: left of the top photo: the exciting news or expectation
left of the bottom photo: the disappointing catch
examples: Your package is out for delivery
